plainText:
Julián Rebolledo (born 1972) is an American actor and voice actor for the English dub of . He is sometimes credited as "Julian Dean".

==Biography==
Rebolledo became an actor and voice actor as an adult. He voiced characters during of the , with the most notable role being that of Paul. In his personal life, he co-owns the New York City dubbing studio Hyperbolic Audio with Sean Reyes. In addition, Rebolledo has provided voice-overs for many television shows and commercials, and has also done some on-camera roles.
